question: An airplane took off from the starting point 45 minutes later than the scheduled time. The destination was 2100 km away from the starting point. To reach on time, the pilot had to increase the speed by 40% of its usual speed. What was the increased speed (in km/h)?
solution:
Given: 

Distance = 2100 km

Started late by = 45 mins = 3/4 hours

Increased the speed by 40%.

Concept used:

Time × Speed = Distance

Calculation:

Let the initial speed of the airplane = V

So, increased speed of the airplane = V + 40% of V = 1.4V
